title: Grusch: the symbol rate is too slow

tellings.quote: actually talking to David Gush about this in my interview with him and he was like it's almost like the symbol rate is too slow.

plain: A former US intelligence official turned whistleblower named David Grusch told Michels, in an interview, that it is almost as if the symbol rate is too slow, meaning the speed at which information can pass is too low. Michels repeats the remark himself in an episode on consciousness and Plato's cave, the old story about mistaking shadows for reality, using it to suggest that human ways of communicating may be too slow to grasp what lies behind UFOs.
